independence.statement: Only the six authorized existing AI label records were surfaced and copied across revisions; the calibration file was otherwise hashed and programmatically filtered. All six retain their original gold and provenance and are explicitly inspected development regressions. The twelve synthetic labels were independently authored in revision 1 using the request text and frozen policy and retained unchanged in revision 2. Candidate code, predictions, reply scores, and other agents' evaluation outputs were not inspected. Inspection limitations here describe this post-pilot labeling task.

interpretation_notes: Security intent does not itself mandate escalation: general prevention questions and explicitly negated incidents remain eligible.
Cancel/leave language is interpreted with its local object; a download or open playlist is not service cancellation or churn.
An attributed device name and figurative gratitude are not harm allegations.
Explicit ear/property harm and a material hearing-safety concern require human handling; injury need not already be confirmed.
An eligible label only removes the mandatory request-risk veto; a current, supported, independently validated reply is still required.
